focus.unavailable: This helper is unavailable for messages.
focus.waitingForFile: No conversation yet. You can still send a message.
focus.hint: Messages wait until the helper is idle. Shift+Enter adds a line.
focus.queued: Queued until the helper is idle.

errors.scope: omp changed chats or restarted. Return to the chat to open its current helpers.
errors.scopeMessage: omp changed chats or restarted. This message was not sent again.

errors.connectionEnded: The chat connection ended. Copy this message before restarting omp, then reopen the helper conversation to send it again.
errors.noParent: This chat has no saved conversation yet.
errors.noFile: The helper's conversation file could not be found.
errors.unreadable: The conversation file could not be read.
errors.unconfirmed: omp did not confirm delivery. Check the conversation before trying again.
errors.cancelled: This message was cancelled before delivery.
